questions.prompt: Which ruler commissioned the Taj Mahal?
questions.fact: He was later deposed by his own son and spent his final years imprisoned in a fort overlooking it.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the tendency of an object to resist changes in motion?
questions.fact: It is why passengers lurch forward when a bus brakes: they keep moving while the bus does not.

questions.prompt: How many holes does a golfer play in a standard professional tournament?
questions.fact: Four rounds of eighteen, with a cut after two, which is why Friday afternoon is often the most tense day.

questions.prompt: Which 1976 film features the fictional network UBS?
questions.fact: Its satire of ratings-driven news is so regularly called prophetic that the phrase has become a cliché about it.

questions.prompt: Which is the world's most populous city proper?
questions.fact: Tokyo leads by metropolitan area while others lead by city limits, which is why rankings disagree so wildly.

questions.prompt: Which term describes writing that reveals a character's unfiltered thoughts?
questions.fact: The final chapter of Ulysses runs for dozens of pages with almost no punctuation at all.

questions.prompt: What is the term for splitting a database across multiple machines?
questions.fact: It makes queries that span shards far more expensive, which is why the split point matters enormously.
